python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data from the table (in millions of dollars)
# Public debt securities held by Government accounts (column 5)
govt_accounts = {
    1995: 1320784,
    1996: 1447001,
    1997: 1598459,
    1998: 1765580,
    1999: 1989072
}

# Public debt securities held by the public (column 8)
public_holdings = {
    1995: 3653199,
    1996: 3777810,
    1997: 3814687,
    1998: 3760613,
    1999: 3667199
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: ln(D_t / D_{t-1})
def calc_log_growth(data):
    growth_rates = []
    years = sorted(data.keys())
    for i in range(1, len(years)):
        prev_val = data[years[i-1]]
        curr_val = data[years[i]]
        log_growth = math.log(curr_val / prev_val)
        growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    return growth_rates

# Calculate population standard deviation
def pop_std(values, mean):
    n = len(values)
    variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / n
    return math.sqrt(variance)

# Calculate coefficient of variation
def calc_cv(values):
    n = len(values)
    mean = sum(values) / n
    std = pop_std(values, mean)
    cv = std / mean if mean != 0 else float('inf')
    return cv, mean, std

govt_growth = calc_log_growth(govt_accounts)
public_growth = calc_log_growth(public_holdings)

govt_cv, govt_mean, govt_std = calc_cv(govt_growth)
public_cv, public_mean, public_std = calc_cv(public_growth)

print("=== Public debt securities held by Government accounts ===")
print(f"Log growth rates: {govt_growth}")
print(f"Mean: {govt_mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {govt_std:.6f}")
print(f"Coefficient of Variation (DSI): {govt_cv:.6f}")

print("\n=== Public debt securities held by the public ===")
print(f"Log growth rates: {public_growth}")
print(f"Mean: {public_mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population Std Dev: {public_std:.6f}")
print(f"Coefficient of Variation (DSI): {public_cv:.6f}")

# Calculate absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(govt_cv - public_cv)
print(f"\n=== Absolute Difference ===")
print(f"Absolute difference: {abs_diff:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest thousandth: {round(abs_diff, 3)}")
EOF
